overview.description: The Avantis Core Fixed Income ETF (AVIG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund offers an active exposure to a broad range of investment-grade debt securities from issuers around the globe. AVIG was launched on Oct 15, 2020 and is issued by American Century Investments.
